幽灵刹车Phantom braking和安全，不可能都满足


TechGeek Tesla 🔋⚡️ (@JonBbC_TechGeek)

As someone who gets a chance to review the latest versions of Tesla‘s full self driving software for HW3 vehicles, one of the top questions I always receive when a new version comes out is “is phantom braking fixed?”
It’s really hard to answer that. It takes a lot of driving before you can provide any worthwhile feedback IMHO. To be honest, it will probably never be fixed. Phantom braking may not seem like a good thing on the surface, however, it’s a necessary evil to protect human lives. The question, in & of itself, is a little crazy to me. How can it ever be fixed? The question should always be: is it better or worse?
When it comes to v14 Lite, it depends on the time of day you’re driving, but it’s still there. Is it worse? It’s so hard to tell. I actually feel like it’s more hesitant and careful than it was before. So, yeah, after 1 week of testing, I’m going to claim that it’s worse. But again, I feel like this is a very situational thing, and I also feel that it’s somewhat subjective. Harsh braking is interpreted differently depending on who you’re talking to. Thoughts on this from other testers, I’d love to hear. @BLKMDL3 @j32pmxr @tesla_raj @RoccoSperanza @Kristennetten @niccruzpatane @koby_pierce
